fields.pdf_field_name: 1 Name of Patient
NRIC  FIN  Passport No_3
Policy No
Company Name
fields.description: Employer / policyholder company name, only if it is stated in the notes

fields.pdf_field_name: 2 Final Diagnosis of illness or extent of injury
fields.description: Final diagnosis of the illness, or extent of injury

fields.pdf_field_name: ICD Code
fields.description: ICD-10 code for the primary diagnosis, if stated or clearly determinable

fields.pdf_field_name: 3 What is the cause of illness  injury
fields.description: Cause of the illness or injury

fields.pdf_field_name: 4 Please specify the approximate date of discovery of the illness or injury
fields.description: Approximate date the illness or injury was discovered (DD/MM/YY if a precise date is known)

fields.pdf_field_name: 5 How long has the illness  injury been existing prior to consulting you
fields.description: How long the illness/injury had been existing before the patient consulted this doctor

fields.pdf_field_name: 6 Did the patient have any symptoms prior to consulting you Yes No If Yes please indicate the nature of Symptoms and date Symptoms first started
fields.description: Nature of symptoms the patient had before consulting, and the date symptoms first started; leave missing if the notes do not say

fields.pdf_field_name: 7 When did the patient first consult you for this condition
fields.description: Date the patient FIRST consulted this doctor for this condition (DD/MM/YY)

fields.pdf_field_name: 8 Nature and Date of Treatment rendered
fields.description: Nature and date(s) of treatment rendered

fields.pdf_field_name: 9 Has the patient ever had the same or similar condition  symptom Yes No Not to my knowledge If Yes please indicate when and describe
fields.description: If the patient previously had the same or a similar condition: when, and a brief description; leave missing if the notes do not say

fields.pdf_field_name: 10 Has the patient had any prior treatment for this condition Yes No Not to my knowledge If Yes please state the following  Name of Doctor First Consultation Date Name of Clinic Address
fields.description: Prior treatment for this condition: doctor's name, first consultation date, clinic name and address; leave missing if the notes do not say

fields.pdf_field_name: 11 Admission Period
fields.description: Hospital admission period, e.g. 12/03/26 to 15/03/26

fields.pdf_field_name: 12 Name of Hospital
fields.description: Name of the hospital the patient was admitted to

fields.pdf_field_name: 13 Date of surgical procedures or treatment rendered
fields.description: Date of surgical procedure or treatment rendered (DD/MM/YY)

fields.pdf_field_name: 14 If excision was performed please indicate the size of the lesion  tumor Please attach a copy of the histology report
fields.description: If an excision was performed, size of the lesion/tumour; leave missing otherwise

fields.pdf_field_name: 15 Describe the surgical procedures or treatment rendered If no surgery was performed please state treatment  medication given
fields.description: Description of surgical procedures performed, or if no surgery, the treatment/medication given

fields.pdf_field_name: Operation Code
fields.description: Surgical operation code, if stated in the notes

fields.pdf_field_name: Operation Table
fields.description: Surgical operation table (Medisave table letter/number), if stated in the notes

fields.pdf_field_name: 19  Is the patient still under your care for this condition Yes No If No please give date service was terminated and furnished name and address of doctor if the patient has been referred to another doctor for followup
fields.description: If care has ended: date service was terminated and, if referred on, the name and address of the receiving doctor; leave missing if still under care

fields.pdf_field_name: Name  Designation
fields.description: Attending physician's name and designation, if stated in the notes

fields.pdf_field_name: Name and Address of Clinic  Hospital  Stamp
fields.description: Name and address of the clinic/hospital, if stated in the notes
